email.body1:
Carmen, saw Seso is expanding into AI-enabled payroll and banking off its Series B.

As the platform grows, the bottleneck in outbound is usually signal-to-action latency: in-market growers get spotted late and reps lose hours to research and CRM instead of meetings. Our AI SDR closes that gap, so the same team books 3-5x more meetings per rep without new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Seso off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Carmen, quick follow-up for Seso.

In most RevOps stacks the drag is not data, it is the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting, which quietly pulls reply rates down. Tightening that loop with the right plays usually lifts response rates 50-70%.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change to cut that latency. Happy to scope it to Seso on the call.
email.body3:
Carmen, last bit of proof for Seso.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Seso's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
